title: mw.partner.recon.v1
description: One line of a partner's reconciliation or settlement file (spec 13 as amended by ticket 86), read by the partner adapter that owns the partner's family from the partner's SFTP host (batch partner route: Kamelets mw-sftp-source, then mw-recon). Every data line of a file is one record; all lines of a file are written through the outbox in one transaction, so a file is published whole or not at all (a file that cannot be read is moved to .error and nothing is published). A file is read once (JDBC idempotent repository on name, size and modification time); the same line of the same file always carries the same mw-idempotency-key header recon/<partnerId>/<fileId>#<lineNumber>, so a consumer deduplicates a redelivery in its inbox. Produced by mw-adapter-billpay (owner), mw-adapter-telco and mw-adapter-bank; consumer: the future mw-recon service (ticket 88; contracts/EXTERNAL.yml until it is built), which matches the lines and never moves money. Key: partnerId. fields holds the partner's columns as text, unparsed: amounts, references and statuses in the partner's own format. Consumers ignore unknown fields; only additive changes within v1.

partnerId.description: The partner id of the batch route's record partner/<id>.

family.description: The family of the reporting adapter.

fileName.description: The file's name on the partner host (without its directory).

fileId.description: The file's identity, <fileName>-<size>-<modified epoch ms> (the idempotent repository's key without the partner id); the same for every line of one file.

lineNumber.description: 1-based line of the file (a header line counts).

last.description: True on the file's last data line: the file is complete.

fields.description: Column name -> the line's value, as text (the route's columns, or the file's header line).

receivedAt.description: When the adapter read the file.
